title: Define Worker Environment Bindings
description: Create src/worker/env.ts defining the WorkerEnv interface with D1Database, DurableObjectNamespace, and AnalyticsEngineDataset bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Includes D1_DB, KEY_POOL, and ANALYTICS bindings with correct types.

exact_signatures: export interface WorkerEnv { D1_DB: D1Database; KEY_POOL: DurableObjectNamespace; ANALYTICS: AnalyticsEngineDataset; }
implementation_notes: Use @cloudflare/workers-types for types like D1Database, DurableObjectNamespace, AnalyticsEngineDataset.
test_scenarios: Verify types are correctly resolved and file compiles without errors.

title: Implement Token Verifier
description: Implement the AuthContract in src/worker/auth.ts to hash bearer tokens and verify them against the D1 database, returning an AuthContext.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens are hashed using SHA-256 before DB lookup.
Handles missing or invalid tokens gracefully.

exact_signatures: export class TokenVerifier implements AuthContract { constructor(private env: WorkerEnv) {} public async verifyToken(bearerToken: string): Promise<AuthContext>; }
contract_snippets: export interface AuthContract { verifyToken(bearerToken: string): Promise<AuthContext>; }
implementation_notes: Use Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.digest) for SHA-256 hashing of the token.
Query D1_DB for the hashed token. Do not store or query plaintext tokens.
test_scenarios: Valid token returns isAuthenticated: true and correct tenantId.

title: Implement Telemetry Emitter
description: Implement TelemetryContract in src/worker/telemetry.ts to stream events to Workers Analytics Engine.

exact_signatures: export class AnalyticsEmitter implements TelemetryContract { constructor(private env: WorkerEnv) {} public emit(event: TelemetryEvent): void; }
contract_snippets: export interface TelemetryContract { emit(event: TelemetryEvent): void; }
implementation_notes: Use env.ANALYTICS.writeDataPoint({ blobs: [event.tenantId, event.eventType, event.traceId], doubles: [event.latencyMs, Number(event.costMicrodollars)] }).
test_scenarios: Calling emit writes a formatted data point to the Analytics Engine dataset.

title: Create Worker Entrypoint
description: Create src/worker/index.ts implementing the Cloudflare Worker fetch handler to authenticate requests and proxy to the KEY_POOL DO.
acceptance_criteria: Worker exports a default object with a fetch method.
Extracts Bearer token and authenticates via TokenVerifier.
Proxies the request to the DO stub.

exact_signatures: export default { async fetch(request: Request, env: WorkerEnv, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<Response>; }
implementation_notes: Ensure DO fetch proxying passes through necessary headers.
Use ctx.waitUntil() for all background telemetry to ensure zero proxy hot path blocking.
test_scenarios: Valid auth routes to correct DO and returns DO response.
